title: Positive-degree injective abelian hypercover section acyclicity
statement: for every positive p, the alternating coface section homology object is zero

proof.text: Apply Hom into I to the positive-degree free abelian components. The free-presheaf Yoneda identification turns the dual complex into the alternating coface section complex, while injectivity preserves exactness, so every positive homology object is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem hypercover_injective_abelian_positive
    {X : Scheme.{w}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U : SplitEtaleHypercover X)
    (I : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1}) [Injective I] :
    ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → IsZero
      (((AlgebraicTopology.alternatingCofaceMapComplex AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1}).obj
          (U.simplicial.rightOp ⋙ I.obj)).homology p)
